newsitem.title: USA: Key Energy sees continued strong growth.
newsitem.headline: Key Energy sees continued strong growth.

text.p: Key Energy Group Inc said Tuesday higher equipment utilization and the impact of recent acquisitions are expected to result in continued strong growth in revenues and profits during the fourth quarter.
The company reported record third quarter, ended March 31, net income of $2.3 million, up 184 percent from $827,000 a year earlier, on a 193 percent increase in revenues to $42.0 million.
"We are pleased with our continued success in our existing operations, as well as our ability to quickly and successfully integrate our recent acquisitions," chief executive Francis D. John said.
During the last two quarters Key has announced and/or completed 16 acquisitions for about $79 million, it noted.

"In the last quarter of the fiscal year, we expect continued strong growth in revenues, earnings and cash flow, stemming mainly from strong, full quarter contributions from most of these acquisitions and higher utilization - in addition to additional strategic acquisitions," John said.
